title: Galakrond and the Five Proto-Dragons
summary: Galakrond's predation draws Tyr and five proto-dragons into a struggle that precedes the dragonflights' rise.
opening: Before the dragonflights had their charge, a hunger threatened the proto-dragons of ancient Azeroth. Tyr's answer depended on five who were not yet Aspects.

chapters.title: Galakrond's hunger
chapters.body: Establish what Galakrond became and why the other proto-dragons could not ignore him. Review the first-party history alongside the original story for the precise origin of his change.

chapters.title: Tyr seeks allies
chapters.body: Trace Tyr's approach to the five proto-dragons and the different reasons they joined the fight. Their later titles should not be projected backward onto this moment.

chapters.title: Five against one
chapters.body: Follow the confrontation with Galakrond and identify each participant's contribution from primary narrative evidence before writing a finished battle sequence.

chapters.title: A charge for the future
chapters.body: Examine why Tyr argued for the five to be empowered after the danger passed, and where the story of the Aspects begins rather than ends.

reviewNote: The official overview is a strong lead; verify detailed motives, battle actions, and northern geography against the original story before promotion.
